# Third-party files served by this app

These are copied in so the app loads no script or stylesheet from another site.

| File | Project | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `htmx-2.0.4.min.js` | [htmx](https://htmx.org) 2.0.4 | Zero-Clause BSD |
| `chart-4.4.1.umd.js` | [Chart.js](https://www.chartjs.org) 4.4.1 | MIT |
| `tailwind.css` | Generated by [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com) 3.4.17 from the classes used in the templates. Rebuild with `python scripts/build_css.py` | MIT |

The Switzer font is the one thing still loaded from outside (Fontshare, Indian Type Foundry).
Its licence allows use on a website but not redistribution of the font files, and this
repository is public, so the files are deliberately not copied here.
